name: Ham & Potato Casserole
description: A layered ham, potato, and cheese casserole cooked in a slow cooker.
recipeIngredient: Cream of mushroom or celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Put half of the ham, potatoes, onions, cheese, salt, and pepper in a slow cooker.
Add the remaining half of the ingredients for the second layer.
Top with soup and sprinkle with paprika.
Cook on slow for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 hours.

_similar.name: Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole topped with bread crumbs and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup grated Cracker Barrel cheddar cheese
½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: ham casserole, potato casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Crunchy Top Ham and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole with a crunchy corn flake topping.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all casserole ingredients and mix well.
Place the mixture in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine topping ingredients (melted butter and crushed corn flakes) and sprinkle on top of the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: ham and potato casserole, crunchy topping, comforting casserole

_similar.name: Macaroni Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and ham casserole topped with cheddar cheese and crushed sour cream and onion potato chips.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 1¼ cups (250 to 375 mL) grated cheddar cheese
Crushed sour cream and onion flavoured potato chips for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cook the macaroni in boiling water, then drain and mix in cubed ham.
Melt margarine in a saucepan and mix in the flour. Add in the milk and stir constantly over medium heat until the mixture is thick and smooth.
Mix the sauce with the macaroni and ham, then pour into a greased casserole dish.
Add salt and pepper to taste, and stir in about ¾ of the grated cheddar cheese.
Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese on top.
Top with crushed sour cream and onion flavoured potato chips.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the casserole is bubbling.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, ham and cheese, comfort food

_similar.name: Meat and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole with ground beef, sliced potatoes, and corn, topped with a savory gravy.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer sliced potatoes in an 8L casserole dish.
Mix the gravy mix with 1 cup water and pour over the potatoes. Add remaining water.
Top with corn and the browned meat mixture.
Cover and cook at 350°F for 50 minutes.

_similar.keywords: meat casserole, potato and corn dish, gravy topping

_similar.description: A hearty potato casserole made with frozen hash browns, cream soups, and grated cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a shallow pan until well combined.
